rationale.intuition: First-gen status 是 T20 need-blind 学校的真实 hook（NACAC 2024 + Arcidiacono SFFA: ~1.5-1.8× admit lift）。Engine 应 reflect 至少 1.5pp 提升。Counselor 的 firstGenMultiplier=1.4 在 Penn RD anchor 5.8% 上应给出 ~2-3pp 净增益。

sources.name: NACAC State of College Admission 2024 §5.3
sources.evidence: First-generation status is rated 'considerable importance' by 30%+ of admissions officers at private nonprofit institutions

sources.name: Arcidiacono SFFA Expert Witness Report 2018
sources.evidence: First-gen applicants at Harvard see 1.5-1.8× the baseline admit rate, controlling for academic profile

sources.name: Penn Common App Data 2024
sources.evidence: First-gen admit rate ~9% vs overall 5.8% (1.55× lift)
